name: add_github_actions_docs_path_filter
description: Skip the full CI job on docs-only changes via paths-ignore; broken applies the filter to push but not pull_request (the common real-world half-fix)
prompts: ci.yml runs the full node test job on every push to main and every pull request - including PRs that only touch a README or the docs/ directory, which waste runner minutes on a build that could never fail. Add a paths-ignore filter of `**.md` and `docs/**` to BOTH the push and pull_request triggers (a filter on only one of them still burns runs on the other event). Keep push scoped to the main branch, and don't touch the job itself.

setup_files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

test_setup_files.check_path_filter.py:
import yaml

with open(".github/workflows/ci.yml") as f:
    wf = yaml.safe_load(f)

triggers = wf.get("on") or wf.get(True)
for event in ("push", "pull_request"):
    cfg = triggers.get(event)
    assert isinstance(cfg, dict), f"{event} trigger must stay configured (branches for push)"
    ignore = cfg.get("paths-ignore") or []
    assert any("md" in p for p in ignore), f"{event}: no **.md entry in paths-ignore"
    assert any("docs" in p for p in ignore), f"{event}: no docs/** entry in paths-ignore"

assert triggers["push"].get("branches") == ["main"], "push.branches changed"

job = wf["jobs"]["test"]
runs = [s.get("run", "") for s in job["steps"]]
assert any("npm ci" in r for r in runs), "npm ci step lost"
assert any("npm test" in r for r in runs), "npm test step lost"

print("PASS path-filter checks")

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "docs/**"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "docs/**"

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
